title: In vitro functional analyses of T and B cells, DCs and macrophages.
protocol: Stimulate T cells with anti-CD3ε and anti-CD28, PMA, ionomycin, and SEB together with irradiated syngeneic spleen cells.
Stimulate purified B cells with anti-IgM F(ab')₂ fragment, anti-CD40, rmIL-4, LPS, and CpG-DNA.
Pulse the culture with 1 μCi of [³H]-thymidine for 8 hours after 2 or 3 days.
Harvest cells and measure [³H]-thymidine incorporation using Microbeta or Matrix 96.
Assay culture supernatants from CD4+ and CD8+ T cells in triplicate for IFN-γ production by ELISA.
Culture purified T cells from C57BL/6 mice for 48 hours with irradiated spleen cells from BALB/c mice.
Measure [³H]-thymidine incorporation in a similar manner as above.
Stimulate BMDCs or macrophages with immobilized anti-CD16, anti-TREM-1, anti-OSCAR, or anti-MAIR-II.
Add isotype-control rat IgGs and 10 μg/ml of soluble mouse gamma globulin to block FcRs.
Stimulate BMDCs or macrophages with Zymosan or oxidized-zymosan.
Analyze the supernatant for IL-2 production using an ELISA kit (BD Bioscience).
Analyze the supernatant for TNF production using an ELISA kit (BD Bioscience).
Analyze the supernatant for IL-6 production using an ELISA kit (BD Bioscience).
Analyze the supernatant for IL-12 production using an ELISA kit (BD Bioscience).
